rationale: First-cut design: balanced mirrors (I_tail=60uA, I_2=180uA, ratio=6), Cc=1.5pF, Rc=1.5k; expect gain > 200, UGBW ~ 100MHz.
Analyst cut 2: lower Cc (1.0pF) and higher gm1 (mn1=16, wn1=2.5u, ln1=45n) to boost UGBW; higher I_2 (mn5=14, mp3=14) and Rc=2k to boost SR and maintain PM.

mn1 8 -> 16, cap 1.5pF -> 1.0pF, res 1500 -> 1800 ohm: double input pair width to boost gm1 ~0.57mS -> ~0.9mS and reduce Cc to increase gm1/(2piCc); expect ugbw 33.2MHz -> 65MHz, slewRate 26.9V/us -> 38V/us, PM ~55deg.
wp3 1.0u -> 2.0u, wp1 1.0u -> 2.0u: double width of mp3 and mp1 to preserve balance while increasing gm6 ~1.4x; expect p2 to push out, ugbw 43MHz -> >60MHz, PM 46.5deg -> >55deg.
